subject.title: fix(zai): send user agent during endpoint detection

question: Should maintainers require a redacted live Z.AI Coding Plan endpoint-detection run before merging this fix, or explicitly accept the linked issue's live before-fix proof plus this branch's source/regression coverage?
rationale: The contributor states they do not have a Z.AI Coding Plan key, so automation cannot supply the missing real-service proof, and multiple open PRs are competing for the same canonical issue.

options.title: Choose one proven canonical branch
options.body: Select one narrow PR with header regression coverage and either redacted live proof or an explicit proof waiver, then close duplicate candidates after it lands.

options.title: Keep the live-proof gate
options.body: Ask a contributor or maintainer with a redacted Z.AI Coding Plan key to add endpoint-detection output before any duplicate PR merges.

options.title: Waive live proof for this patch
options.body: Maintainers can accept the issue's live 429/200 evidence plus this PR's focused code/test shape, but should still land only one duplicate fix.

recommendation.title: Choose one proven canonical branch
recommendation.body: Select one narrow PR with header regression coverage and either redacted live proof or an explicit proof waiver, then close duplicate candidates after it lands.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature-history trail points to steipete as the original Z.AI endpoint-detection owner and the best routing candidate for the proof/canonical-branch decision.
